title: I have an idea for a game. I’m looking for help and guidance. I have an idea for a game.

selftext: I’m somewhat new to programming, so I’m looking for some help and guidance. I don’t want to use AI; I want to bring this game to life myself. I’m 15 years old, and I want to learn and pour as much love as poss

replies.author: nayheyxus
replies.body: Well you came to the wrong spot to find support for non ai dev, if you want a mentor look for one in r/gamedev . Though be advised you're unlikely to find someone who wants to build a game for you, every kid born before the 80's has a game idea and I don't mean to be offensive, but its an unrealistic goal to find a real programmer who wants to train some young kid in building an idea that isnt their own.

comments.author: Useful_Use_6170
comments.body: Wrong channel my dude! We use AI here, and we pour our soul! And $100 subscription into all our games

comments.author: je386
comments.body:
You don't want to use AI but go to the AI gamedev sub; you talk about an idea for a game, but you don't tell us about; you don't even ask a question to answer.

How can we help you if you don't ask?

If you have no idea to start: best is to not try to make your dream game first, but make supersmall games (like pong or tetris), continue with a bit larger and when you know what you do, then do your larger game.

Check out the different game engines and languages, try them out so you know whichnis the right for your game later.

And be patient. A good game can take years to make even if you are a good developer in the first place or even with a team.

replies.author: REYREX320
replies.body: Gracias gracias. Es que no encontraba donde poner el mensaje ya que en todos los lugares me bloqueaban y termine llegando aquí. Gracias por el consejo, voy a intentar

comments.author: Cool_Permission6791
comments.body: There are lots of ways to learn to code; I HIGHLY recommend learning how the architecture of a program works, what “good code” means, and, if you don’t want to use AI, go to school for software engineering.
